# Streets font fixtures

Test fixtures for the local font pipeline: the five faces Streets letters with, declared as a
map's own `fonts`. Official maps draw these fonts from Tileflow's official glyph set and do not
ship font files.

DINish Medium and Bold are unmodified files from
[DINish revision a5f3b2a3b932336225815bf9005e3b72cc3de71c](https://github.com/playbeing/dinish/tree/a5f3b2a3b932336225815bf9005e3b72cc3de71c/fonts/ttf/DINish).
`LICENSE-DINish.txt` preserves the complete upstream SIL Open Font License 1.1 notice.

Noto Sans Regular, Bold and Italic are unmodified static hinted files from
[Noto revision c971829a87e7920f960e7277c3dafd9bedd3c601](https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/tree/c971829a87e7920f960e7277c3dafd9bedd3c601/hinted/ttf/NotoSans).
`LICENSE-NotoSans.txt` preserves their complete upstream SIL Open Font License 1.1 notice.

`LICENSE.txt` combines both complete notices, as the font pipeline requires one per directory.
